title: Rethinking the Value and Emission Implications of Green Bonds
eligible_reason: No staggered TWFE design. Announcement-return regressions are cross-sectional; the secondary-market test regresses bond yields/returns on a bond-level green_bond indicator (time-invariant for a bond) with issuer and month FE, i.e. a green-vs-conventional comparison, not a switching treatment; environmental-performance regressions use gb_issuer or post_issuance with time-varying firm controls and industry-year plus country-year FE but no firm FE.
design_notes: Replication_code_green_bond_paper.do: Tables 1-3 CAR regressions (reghdfe noabsorb, firm controls); Table 4 reghdfe yield_w/ret green_bond, absorb(cusip6 modate); Table 5 MSCI risk scores on gb_issuer + size, leverage, ROE, sales growth with industry-year and country-year FE; Table 6 DealScan loan spreads; appendix Table B6 post_issuance (switches on at the firm's issuance date) among issuers only, with time-varying controls and no firm FE.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: post_issuance (appendix) varies by issuance date but is estimated without firm FE and with time-varying controls; not a qualifying design.
data_access: licensed (Bloomberg, MSCI, Compustat, Refinitiv, DealScan; not shipped)
data_files_note: Code, codebook and cleaning steps only; no data files.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
